cohort: 138 pregnancies with type 2 diabetes and 27,075 pregnancies in women without diabetes, singleton births > 20 weeks gestation at a specialist maternity network in Australia from 2010 to 2013
finding: Despite preconception care, good glycemic control, and specialist management, type 2 diabetes remains associated with increased adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with type 2 diabetes had a higher risk of cesarean section compared to women without diabetes.
